title: Send form-encoded data with curl
summary: Send a POST request with form data (application/x-www-form-urlencoded). This is commonly used to submit simple forms or interact with APIs that expect form fields.

steps.explain: Use -X POST to specify the method and -d to send the form-encoded data.

placeholders.name: DATA
placeholders.description: The form data to send, e.g. name=bob

placeholders.name: URL
placeholders.description: The URL to send the request to
